profile.legal_name: DRB Group (The Development & Residential Building Group; operating entities include DRB Group Mid-Atlantic LLC, DRB Group North Carolina LLC, DRB Group Texas, LLC)
profile.parent: Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. (via Sumitomo Forestry America, Inc.)

regions.name: Area (William Cutler)
regions.geography: Includes Atlanta, GA (he is also Acting Division President, Atlanta); full list of divisions not published

regions.name: Area (Lindy Oliva)
regions.geography: Includes Houston and San Antonio, TX (she is also Acting Division President there); likely the Texas divisions taken over from Brightland Homes (Austin, Dallas/Ft. Worth), not confirmed

regions.name: Florida area
regions.geography: Orlando and Tampa divisions, plus Jacksonville and Southwest Florida expansion (per DRB's 2025 SVP Area President job posting, Orlando-based)

profile.org_note: CEO Ronny Salameh -> EVP & COO Edwin Woods -> four Area Presidents (Cutler, Oliva, Schueftan, Granelli) -> 19 divisions, which DRB's own site also calls '19 Regions' across 35 markets; DRB does not publish which divisions each area covers. Land is run at area and division level: DRB's 2025 Area President posting puts the area's land pipeline, land books and 'future land deals' under the Area President, each division has its own VP of Land Acquisition, and no corporate head of land is named publicly.
profile.summary: Sumitomo Forestry's largest US homebuilder: 19 divisions in 14 states after absorbing Brightland Homes on 2025-04-01; the company describes itself as the third-largest private US homebuilder.
